buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (For Annual Maintenance Contract of Photocopier Machine) 1. The rates to be quoted should be inclusive of cost and all taxes etc. 2. The firm should have valid GSTIN (upload copy). 3. The firm should have an experience of at least 03 years in AMC of photocopiers along with client satisfa ctory report in at least three Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies.

4. It shall be obligatory on the part of the contractor to carry out maintenance of photocopiers under his di rect control & supervision and under no circumstances the work shall be assigned to sub-contractor. 5. The work shall be carried out in the premises of the Department i.e. Central Agency Section (CAS). Only such work execution which is not possible in the premises of the CAS may be allowed to be done in the off ice of the firm. 6. The delay caused, if any, through negligence or otherwise, shall be at the risk, cost and responsibility of the contractor. The financial or any other loss suffered by the Government on this account shall be compe nsated by the contractor and the decision of the CAS in this context shall be binding on the contractor. 7. This contract will be valid for a period of two years from the date of award of contract. However, the sa me can be terminated even before the scheduled date of its expiry in case the firm fails to provide satisfactory services or comply with any of the terms and conditions of the contract, failing which the secu rity money deposited by the firm will also be liable to be forfeited. The decision of the CAS in this regard will be final and binding on the contractor. 8. The successful bidder shall be required to enter into an agreement with the Department as per the prov isions of GFR-2017. 9. The CAS reserves the right to reject any or all the bids without assigning any reason therefore. 10. Taxes will be deducted at source as per rules. 11. If any dispute(s) arises between the CAS and the firm with reference to the contract, the CAS will decid e it and its decision will be binding on the firms. 12. The successful bidder will be required to deposit a sum of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand only) as performance security money in the form of Bank Guarantee/Fixed Deposit in a Commercial Bank in fav our of 'DDO, Central Agency Section' payable at New Delhi, which will be refundable after satisfactory co mpletion of the contract. If at any stage the services of the firm are not found suitable/appropriate, the co ntract shall be liable to be terminated and security deposit shall also be liable to be forfeited. 13. It may be specially noted that the bid not meeting even the basic cost of the inputs, i.e. unreasonably l ow prices just to undercut and obtain contract, are liable to be ignored to maintain the required standards of work being awarded. The unrealistic rates shall not be entertained and reasonability of rates shall be as certained according to the item of works. 14. The bidder must quote only one rate for any particular item for which he is capable of giving as per the specification and the rate column of no item must be left blank or mentioned as free service. 15. The contract shall be valid for two years with effect from the date of its acceptance and may be exten ded for another one year, if required by mutual consent of the Department and the contractor. The extend ed contract may be extended on the same rate, terms & conditions. 16. In case the firm/agency wants to terminate the contract, it shall have to give three calendar months' n otice of its intention. 17. Notwithstanding any clause in these documents, if the assigned work is not completed to the satisfacti on of the CAS, no payment will be made for that work and the decision of the Department shall be final in that regard. 18. The CAS reserves the right to withhold payment in the event of non-commencement or unsatisfactory performance by the selected bidder. In such eventuality, the CAS further reserves the right to get the wor k done from the open market at the cost of the contractor. The selected bidder will be blacklisted by the G overnment for a period of four years to participate in any type of tender and his security money shall also be forfeited. 19. If any information furnished by the selected bidder is found to be incorrect or false at any time, the co ntract will be liable to be terminated without any notice and the security deposit is liable to be forfeited. 20. The following self-attested documents must be uploaded on GeM portal: (i) GST registration; (ii) PAN card; (iii) Copy of GST & IT return for the last three years; (iv) Scanned copy of undertaking from agency for no police case/no vigilance case pending/not punis hed by any court; (v) A bid-specific authorization certificate of a reputed brand of photocopier machines must be uploa ded along with the documents;

(vi) Certificate of non-liquidation/non-court receivership/non-bankruptcy. An undertaking to be uploa ded; (vii) The bidder should not have been blacklisted by any Central/State Govt./Semi Govt./PSU/Autono mous body; (viii) Similar nature of work in any three Ministries/Departments/PSUs. The bidder must have successf ully executed/completed similar services over the last three years, i.e. current financial year and the l ast three financial years (ending month of March prior to the bid opening) [work orders to be uploade d]: (a) Three similar completed services costing not less than 40% (forty percent) of the estimated cost; or (b) Two similar completed services costing not less than 50% (fifty percent) of the estimated cost; or (c) One similar completed service costing not less than 80% (eighty percent) of the estimated cost. *MSE/Start-up Bidders are to be exempted. A valid MSE Certificate must be provided. (x) The office location of the bidder shall be located in Delhi only; certificate related to official addres s has to be uploaded; (xi) Minimum average annual turnover of the bidder during the last three financial years ending on 31 st March, 2026 should be Rs. 15 lakh and bidder net-worth should be positive in last three financial y ears ending on 31.03.2026 (Statement certified by Chartered Accountant to be uploaded). Valid MSE/ Startup Bidders are to be exempted. (xii) The firm should be ESI/EPF registered firm 3 years prior to issue of this bid. (Copy of certificate t o be atttached). (xiii) All the partcipating firms are required to visit the Central Agency Section to understand the4 nat ure of services. Timelines and quality to be provided. The firm shall obtained certificate in this regard from the Admin-CAS Section, 2nd floor, Indian Law Institute, New Delhi which must be uploaded with the bid documents. The firm failing to visit the CAS shall be summarily rejected while technical evalu ation; (xiv) Bidders shall submit the EMD (Earnest Money Deposit) @ 2% of the bid value. (valid MSE/Start-u p Bidders are to be exempted, subject to valid supporting documents for the relevant category); (xv). IP Address should be unique. 21. In case of any contradiction between the GeM T&C and the Scope of Work and General/Special T&C upl oaded hereby, the latter shall prevail over the GeM T&C. .
